player_prompt.intro:
O moswi wa {player_id}. O tlisa ḓimothobo ya Battleship.
Thelelo ya gago ke go tshwara ḓimothobo tsotlhe tsa mmoloki pele ba gago tshwara.
Ka nako ya gago, o ka o tshwara ḓimothobo kwa koordinete tsotlhe ka tsela e e latelang: '[a4]'. Fa ḓimothobo e tshwara, e bontshwa ke 'X'. Fa e se ka wa tshwara, e bontshwa ke 'O'. Mo mafolofolo a mabedi, seabe sa ḓimothobo se tla go tsebisa ka tshwaro ya gago. Fa o ka tshwara ḓimothobo, seabe sa ḓimothobo se tla go tsebisa!
Ḓimothobo e fela fa ḓimothobo tsotlhe tsa moswi a le mongwe di tshwarwe.
Pasi ya gago ya mathomo e tla bontsha ḓimothobo tsotlhe tsa gago di sulafetswe, le tshwaro ya mmoloki mo go wena, le tshwaro le ga o tshwara mo pasi ya mmoloki bale bangwe ḓimothobo tsa mmoloki di bonala.
Ene ke pasi ya mathomo:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Motshameki o ne a sa arabe ka go kwala leina la lefelo le le tshwanetseng mo dikholomong tse di sekwere.
invalid_move.out_of_board: Kgolagano {coord} e kwa ntle ga boto.
